OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
HOW TO VIEW THE MEETING: The meeting will be livestreamed and hosted via Zoom Webinar. You may attend remotely by joining the meeting link provided below.

Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council receive and file financial statements for the months ending April 30, 2026, and May 31, 2026.

PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING ACTIONS
Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council receive and file the action minutes for the June 16, 2026, Planning Commission Meeting.
Minutes
5.
PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH BKF, FORMERLY MNS, TO CONTINUE TO PROVIDE SENIOR PLANNER LEVEL PROFESSIONAL CONTRACT PLANNING SERVICES FOR FY 2026-27
Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council Approve the Professional Services Agreement with BKF (formerly MNS), extending the term of the Agreement for one (1) additional year to June 30, 2027, and authorize the City Manager to execute the PSA for FY 2026-27.
Staff Report
6.
CONCEPTUAL APPROVAL OF PROPOSAL BY OLMSTED NETWORK TO PLACE PALOS VERDES STONE AND PLAQUE IN OLMSTED PARK
Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council provide conceptual approval for the placement of a Palos Verdes stone and commemorative plaque, to be provided by the Olmsted Network, in Olmstead Park.
Staff Report
Attachment
7.
HORIST CONSTRUCTION DONATION
Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council authorize the Mayor to accept a donation to the City from Horist Construction consisting of approximately 700 cubic yards of clean soil and associated grading and placement services along the Boundary Trail, with an estimated value of $17,088.
Staff Report
Attachment
8.
ACCEPT AND APPROVE THE APPOINTMENT OF MEMBERS OF THE FINANCE ADVISORY COMMITTEE, PARKLANDS COMMITTEE, TRAFFIC SAFETY COMMITTEE, AND PLANNING COMMISSION, AND THE MAYOR’S APPOINTMENTS OF COMMITTEE AND COMMISSION CHAIRPERSONS AND VICE CHAIRPERSONS
Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council City Council approve appointments listed herein.
Staff Report
9.
ACCEPTANCE OF DONATION OF STIPEND AMOUNT FROM CITY TREASURER MARTIN PETERSEN AND AUTHROIZATION TO ACCEPT ONGOING MONTHLY STIPENDS
Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council City Council accept a donation of $2,700 from City Treasurer Martin Petersen and authorize staff to accept an ongoing monthly stipend as a donation to the City.
Staff Report
Attachment
10.
ADOPT RESOLUTION R26-22 FOR THE GENERAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION TO BE HELD AND CONDUCTED ON NOVEMBER 3, 2026
Recommendation: It is recommended that City Council Approve Resolution No. R26-22 calling for the holding of a General Municipal Election to be held on Tuesday, November 3, 2026.
Staff Report
Attachment

Approve Amendment No. 2 of the professional services agreement with Robert Linkroum for professional videography services for filming of public meetings maintaining the hourly rate and extending the term until December 31, 2026.
2.
